notes.title: Christmas Content Available - Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Renovators![/b][/h1]

[h2]Christmas is here - check out new items and decorations available in TSR![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/5bb8dcaaeba8066f1b56db42a5a8e28c053b73a7.png[/img]

[u]We are happy to let you know that you can now find extra items available in our game[/u]! If you ever wanted to make your station feel a little bit more Christmasy - now is the best time to do so! Make sure that the station you're currently working on oozes of Christmas spirit and that all carolers in the vicinity would like to come and visit! 

Some of the items you can recognize from last year will also make their return and together with the freshly added [u]the number of Christmas items you'll be able to find reaches almost 50[/u]! 🎄

What is more - we've made some important changes to the achievements. We believe that majority of the reported issues with achievements not registering properly should be fixed now - we'd love to hear back from you regarding whether the achievements issues have been completely fixed. 
You might have to go through the tutorial once in order for the achievements to show up properly! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/e32860a44d86235d136d9663b0c2386f9bcd8549.png[/img]

We at Live Motion Games would also like to wish you a great and merry Christmas! Have a lot of fun experiences and moments with those closest to you and enjoy yourself! 

Even the best of us need to take a break from time to time and what time would be better than the time of merriness and joy? Christmas is time where we all should relax and enjoy ourselves and we certainly hope you're spending your time now with a smile on your face reconnecting with your friends or simply playing your favourite game!

Build a snowman, eat something tasty, relax in a comfortable armchair and refuel your engines so they're ready for future challenges but also great opportunities! And if you're more active and prefer to dance around the Christmas tree just remember to not knock it over! 

[u]Merry Christmas![/u]

Best regards
Train Station Renovation team

notes.title: Train Station Renovation Devlog#54 - "All new maps" (4days left)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/119f536804213637523ab010289d2971f7aa5ce6.png[/img]

[h2]Today we want to show you and describe all 5 maps that will appear in the full game.[/h2]

[h3]The first map is in the forest with the train tunnel. This is where we will have most of the tasks to be done.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/d311712708225e9981fed07c2e2ff5e0717a906a.png[/img]

[h3]On the next map, you will find a lot of trains and traction gears. In addition to repairing the trains, there will be a special task for you.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/fe1d997ff005c50b37d4abe00da1d38f8293ba09.png[/img]

[h3]You wrote a lot about the underground station, so at your request, we are adding metro stations to the game.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/8df94c16605c2dfb86ec65f309fd05d1571163b1.png[/img]

notes.title: Train Station Renovation Devlog#39 "Summary After Event!"
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Railfans![/b][/h1]

Yesterday was a great day - we streamed our game, we asked you to come and you did! It was amazing! We really thank you for all kind words and that you were with us on that special event! There were around 500 of you! It is amazing, thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33426656/7a422e619430f6f35ed2fb12897a0b03ea5065ad.jpg[/img]

There was some question and as we can see, you still are asking them - we will answer it here.

Q: What will be price of the game
A: It depends on you! Basic price will be 15$ BUT! If you manage to get 6k people to follow our Steam Web Page then we will make a discount for the launch! 

Q: I have a problem - I can play only tutorial
A: Make sure, you downloaded Train Station Renovation - First Job and you start the game as “New Game”. Otherwise go to our steam discussion - we will resolve your problem!

Q: Will be there another event for Early Access release?
A: Yes! We will make another event - but a bigger one! We will post more details soon!

Q:Will the game have achievements?
A: Yes - it will have! We prepared a lot of them so there will be a lot of work if you decide to collect all of them!

Q: How many levels will be there?
A: In Early Access we will have the first ten levels. Later we will tell you more - don’t worry!

notes.title: Train Station Renovation Devlog#31 "More about Upgrade System"
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Railfans![/b][/h1]

In today's devlog we want to tell you more about upgrades and what you can expect.
Last time we talked about sponge and its upgrade – today we will talk about upgrades in general.
 
[previewyoutube=WNFh7Yt8law;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see in the video, there are plenty of upgrades. All of them are equal for faster working and better quality of life! One of the first questions that will be in the head of a lot of people is – and how do I buy those upgrades? What is the currency, what is the system?
 
Answer is simple – at this point we think the best solution is to put effort in cleaning every level and progress – first we clean the station, then we earn stars. We buy upgrades for those stars! So the more stations are renovated, the more stars we earn so we can buy more and better upgrades.
 
And take a note, that prices in this video are not definitive and may change
 
[b]Questions from players:[/b]

Q: Is upgrading our tools necessary? 
A: No, it is not! But it is something that, as mentioned above, will help you renovate the station quickly.

Q: Is there any way, besides the stars, to upgrade our tools? 
A: Not at his point and it won’t change. We think that effort you put into clearing stages should profit you more, than just finishing any level just at one star.

Q: Will there be any more upgrades of our tools like axe or paddle cutter? 
A: Maybe in the future – but not at this point. We still see some places where we could use some tools for upgrades. We will see what we will do in the future!

Q: Can I buy a max level of upgrade and skip one? 
A: No, you must upgrade every tool in each tree. So you cannot skip from i.e. wrench to the drill
 
Of course you could have more questions – do not hesitate to ask them in discussion! And as always, give us your thoughts about the upgrade system!


[i][b]Thank you very much for following our work on the game and we hope that soon we will be able to show you the result of our hard work.[/b][/i]

Best regards
Train Station Renovation team
